summary: Feed s174_triple is degraded: NDR receives incomplete/incorrect traffic - 19.5% duplicates, VLAN 20 missing (49% untagged), and 3.8% TCP packet loss causing gaps in flows.

findings.root_cause: Traffic is being duplicated before the NDR - likely two SPAN/TAP feeds carrying the same packets aggregated without deduplication, or both sides of a link forwarded separately to the same tool port. 541 of 2768 packets (19.5%) are duplicates, well above 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage on duplicate packets, inflates flow counts and alerts, skews deduplication/analytics and can mask true anomalies.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets within a short window before delivery to NDR, preserving single copy for analysis.

findings.root_cause: VLAN tags are being stripped in the visibility path. Required VLAN 20 not seen and 49% of packets are untagged, indicating SPAN or packet broker trunk is configured to strip 802.1Q or not forwarding VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation and detection coverage. Without VLAN 20 visibility, lateral movement and tenant-specific attacks in that VLAN are invisible and correlation by VLAN fails.

recommended_fix.why: Configure TAP/SPAN and packet broker to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward VLANs 10 and 20 to the NDR tool port.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN is dropping packets under load before they reach the NDR. 100 of 2666 TCP packets (3.8%) show gaps/retransmissions indicating missing data, above 1% threshold, while tool overload is healthy so drops are upstream of the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload and both directions; missing packets break TCP reassembly, cause incomplete flows, missed payload inspection and allow evasions to go undetected.

recommended_fix.why: Reduce loss by load-balancing across multiple NDR tool ports or broker egresses with flow-aware hashing, and verify SPAN/TAP is not oversubscribed - replace SPAN with TAP if drops persist.
